about.title: About Ethiopia Tour & Travel
about.subtitle: Founded in Addis Ababa by passionate local guides, we've spent over 15 years sharing Ethiopia's extraordinary story with the world.
about.missionTitle: Connecting the World to Ethiopia's Soul
about.missionP1: Ethiopia is not just a destination — it's a living museum of human civilization. Home to the oldest human fossil, the magnificent rock-hewn churches of Lalibela, the ancient Axumite obelisks, and over 80 unique ethnic groups.
about.missionP2: Our mission: design unforgettable journeys that respect Ethiopia's culture, support its communities, and leave our travelers with memories that last a lifetime.

safety.title: Safety First
safety.desc: All tours are fully insured and led by certified, experienced guides.

community.title: Community Impact
community.desc: We support local guides, artisans, and communities at every destination.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.desc: 500+ five-star reviews and consistent recognition by tourism bodies.

global.title: Global Reach
global.desc: Serving travelers from 40+ countries who trust us to show them Ethiopia.
